server.name: ad.tributs/mcp
server.description: Read-only access to Andorran accounting and tax data in Tributs: invoices, bank, IGI filings.
server.title: Tributs

server.name: io.github.Eszetael/postgres-mcp-hardened
server.description: Read-only PostgreSQL over MCP. Writes refused at the parsed SQL, plus a READ ONLY transaction.
server.title: PostgreSQL (hardened, read-only)

environmentVariables.description: Connection string for the role the server connects as. Use a role that cannot write — the server refuses writes twice, but a read-only role is the layer that does not depend on us being correct. `--print-setup-sql` prints the SQL that creates one.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Server-side statement timeout, e.g. `5s`. A question that would pin the database is cancelled by PostgreSQL, not by hope.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist. A table off the list is refused by name, and hiding it inside a CTE, a view or a join does not help.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_TABLES

environmentVariables.description: Path to the tamper-evident audit log. Entries are chained by hash and survive a restart; `--verify-audit` checks the chain against an off-host anchor.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUDIT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Connection string for a role that cannot write.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

server.name: io.github.AIops-tools/postgres-aiops
server.description: Governed PostgreSQL DBA ops: slow-query RCA, bloat/vacuum & blocking-lock analysis; 35 MCP tools.
server.title: Postgres AIops

server.name: com.devart/mcp-postgresql
server.description: Schema-aware read/write access to PostgreSQL through Devart dotConnect ADO.NET data provider.
server.title: Devart MCP Server for PostgreSQL (ADO.NET)

environmentVariables.description: A dotConnect for PostgreSQL connection string.

license_key.description: Devart dotConnect for PostgreSQL license key, from the Devart Customer Portal.

port.description: Port the PostgreSQL server listens on.

server.description: PostgreSQL host name or network address.

environmentVariables.name: DEVART_MCP_POSTGRESQL_CONNECTION
